clue.text: Boob gets married — I use catcall crudely

parts.note: M is the standard abbreviation for married, as on forms and in genealogies

indicators.note: done crudely, the letters of the phrase are roughly knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone gets married and then makes the gaffe of jeering at the wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boob' is the noun-or-verb sense of a blunder, used here as a verb: to boob is to slip up.
explanation.definitionFit: A boob is a blunder or error, the result of getting one's sums or judgement wrong.

clue.text: Bank below motorway's more obscure

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece placed below another comes after it

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway (as in the M1), and 's stands for is
a bank of seats is a tier, one row above another

explanation.surface: A grassy bank under a motorway is apparently murkier than you'd think.
explanation.definitionFit: Mistier means foggier, so harder to see through and hence less clear.

clue.text: Fast-rising odds gathering support

indicators.note: gathering means holding the other piece inside, collecting it in

parts.note: SP is starting price, the odds offered on a horse at the off
a tee supports a golf ball before it is struck

explanation.surface: Betting odds that shorten fast as money for a favourite comes in.
explanation.definitionFit: A steep slope climbs sharply, rising quickly over a short distance.

clue.text: From oaf, term at Harvard produces results

indicators.note: From says the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A clumsy student's term at an Ivy League university yields consequences.
explanation.definitionFit: An aftermath is the consequences following an event, typically an unpleasant one.

clue.text: Munch cold cut

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
to hew is to cut with an axe

explanation.surface: An instruction to eat sliced cold meat.
explanation.definitionFit: To munch is to chomp steadily and audibly with the jaws.

clue.text: Coastal area lacking imagination, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word is identified by how it is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: a literal person takes words at face value, without imagination

explanation.surface: A dull stretch of seaside, by all accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: The littoral is the shore region, the zone along a sea or lake's edge.

clue.text: Symbol of support on head of Mohican

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece on another sits above it

parts.note: to tote is to carry, bearing the weight of something

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An emblem worn atop a punk's Mohican hairstyle.
explanation.definitionFit: A totem is an emblem, a sacred object standing for a clan or group.

clue.text: Running topless and making an impression

indicators.note: topless in a down answer means the top letter is removed

parts.note: sprinting is running at full speed

explanation.surface: A streaker running bare-chested certainly makes an impression.
explanation.definitionFit: Printing presses ink onto paper, literally making an impression.

clue.text: Crush bottom in endeavour to wear skimpy costume

indicators.note: to wear is to have something around you, so the letter goes inside the costume

parts.note: a thong is a scanty G-string swimsuit or undergarment

indicators.note: bottom in a down clue means the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Squeezing one's backside into a tiny swimsuit takes effort.
explanation.definitionFit: A crush is a dense crowd of people, which is what a throng is.

clue.text: Fancy chair occupied by male after little time

indicators.note: a seat occupied by something has it inside

parts.note: a chair is a seat

indicators.note: after places the following piece behind the one before it

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little

explanation.surface: An ornate chair taken by a man who arrived a little later.
explanation.definitionFit: A fancy is a small iced cake or confection, as is a sweetmeat.

clue.text: Light captured by Monet or Chagall

indicators.note: captured by says the word is held within the following letters

explanation.surface: Light as painted by two great artists.
explanation.definitionFit: A torch is a portable lamp or flaming brand giving illumination.

clue.text: The compiler's left to provide meaning

parts.note: the compiler refers to themself, I, and 's stands for am, giving I'm
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: The setter has departed, leaving some significance behind.
explanation.definitionFit: The import of words is their sense or significance.

clue.text: Company soldier died protected by second soldier

indicators.note: protected by means surrounded by the following piece

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second
a man is a private soldier, one of the ranks

explanation.surface: A soldier in a company falls despite cover from another.
explanation.definitionFit: A commando is a soldier trained for raids, a member of an elite unit.

clue.text: Encore of Queen record with Plant

parts.note: R stands for Regina, Latin for queen
an EP is an extended-play record
to lay something is to put it down, as one plants a mine

explanation.surface: Queen playing an encore with Robert Plant of Led Zeppelin.
explanation.definitionFit: A replay is a repeat performance, as an encore is.

clue.text: Untouched can must be gripped by force

indicators.note: gripped by means held inside the following piece

parts.note: to prise is to force open with a lever
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: An unopened can must be levered open.
explanation.definitionFit: Pristine means in original condition, as yet unspoilt.

clue.text: Thin and starving finally after fish

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word

parts.note: angling is going after fish with a rod

explanation.surface: Skinny and hungry after trying to catch a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' looks like a placing signal, but 'after fish' is one phrase meaning fishing.
explanation.definitionFit: Gangling describes someone tall, thin and awkward of limb.

clue.text: Beautify a girl with some sprucing up

indicators.note: sprucing up means tidying, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Making a girl prettier with a bit of grooming.
explanation.definitionFit: To beautify is to make something more attractive, adding glamour to it.

clue.text: Wood covering empty mango's top …

indicators.note: covering means the wood goes around the other piece

parts.note: a forest is a wood

indicators.note: empty means remove the inner letters, leaving only the outside ones

explanation.surface: Trees shade the top of a hollowed-out mango.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after mango stands for is, linking wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Foremost means first in rank or importance, the leading one.

clue.text: Seaside town beginning to be fashionably left-wing?

indicators.note: beginning to points to the first letter of the next word

parts.note: right-on means holding fashionable liberal or leftish views

explanation.surface: A south-coast resort seems to be turning trendy and liberal.
explanation.walkthrough: BRIGHTON is a resort on England's south coast, known for its liberal politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Brighton is a resort town on the English south coast.

clue.text: … bough with top of bough spread

indicators.note: top of in a down clue means the first letter

parts.note: a spread is a large farm or ranch, especially in America

explanation.surface: A tree limb with its tip spreading out.
explanation.definitionFit: A bough is a main limb of a tree, which is a branch.

clue.text: Drive round the bend following British car

indicators.note: following means the next piece comes after the first

parts.note: to drive someone round the bend is to make them furious, to anger them

explanation.surface: Driving a clapped-out British car drives one mad.
explanation.definitionFit: A banger is slang for a dilapidated old motor car.

clue.text: Arbitrator's swallowing deceit from substitutes

indicators.note: swallowing means taking the other piece inside

parts.note: a referee arbitrates, and ref's is the arbitrator's
a lie is a deceit

explanation.surface: A referee spots trickery from the players coming on.
explanation.definitionFit: Reliefs are people who take over from others, replacements on a shift.

clue.text: Tars at sea circling lake in vessels

indicators.note: circling means going around the other piece
at sea means confused, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: tars are sailors, and the word's letters are the fodder
Erie is one of the North American Great Lakes

explanation.surface: Sailors afloat sail around a lake in their ships.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessels' suggests boats, but they are blood vessels; 'at sea' makes ARTS from TARS.
explanation.definitionFit: Arteries are blood vessels carrying blood from the heart.

clue.text: Recovery establishment helping addicts' behaviour initially

definitions.text: Recovery establishment helping addicts' behaviour initially

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of each of the words

explanation.surface: A clinic that helps addicts change their behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: Rehab is a clinic for treatment of drug or alcohol dependency.

clue.text: Former politician effectively chasing work in retirement

indicators.note: chasing means following behind the other piece
retiring means going back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
doing something well is doing it effectively

explanation.surface: A former MP still busy at work after retiring.
explanation.walkthrough: Enoch Powell was a controversial British Conservative politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Enoch Powell was a British MP and cabinet minister, now dead.

clue.text: Muse seeing her reaction, oddly removed

indicators.note: oddly removed means drop the first, third, fifth letters and so on

explanation.surface: An inspiring goddess watches her response vanish strangely.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato is the Greek Muse of lyric and love poetry.

clue.text: Obscure English coin

parts.note: to obscure is to dim, make less bright

explanation.surface: An unusual old English coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A dime is a US ten-cent coin.

clue.text: Carbon measurement should offer certainty

parts.note: C is the chemical symbol for carbon
an inch is a unit of length measurement

explanation.surface: Carbon dating should give an assured result.
explanation.definitionFit: A cinch is a sure thing, something easy and certain.

clue.text: Old judge catching one with trap to begin

indicators.note: catching means holding the other piece inside

parts.note: to rate is to judge or assess
I is the Roman numeral one
a gin is a snare or trap for game

explanation.surface: An old judge snares someone with a trap to start things off.
explanation.definitionFit: To originate is to start, to come into being.

clue.text: Drunken bore's posture becomes unruly

indicators.note: drunken suggests staggering about, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A tipsy bore's swaying stance makes him rowdy.
explanation.definitionFit: Obstreperous means noisy and difficult to control.
